title: Showpad Review: Features, Pricing and Alternatives for Sales Practice
summary: A Showpad review for October 2026: content, training, Roleplay AI and Pitch AI, how pricing works, the Bigtincan merger, and alternatives for sales practice.
body_markdown:
What to test


How to run it


Score 0, 1 or 2


Buyer pushback


Two senior reps run the scenario at the hardest level and rate whether the buyer resisted like a real one.


0 if the buyer folds, 2 if reps say it matched


Your scorecard


Load your own criteria and check that feedback cites the moment behind each score.


0 if generic, 2 if your criteria with evidence


Deal context


Build a scenario for one live deal and check the buyer knows the account.


0 if generic, 2 if it uses your deal


Retry one moment


Ask the rep to replay only the pricing or objection moment.


0 if full restart only, 2 if they can start at the moment


Call format


Run the call you sell: a committee call, a technical demo with a shared screen, a renewal.


0 if not supported, 2 if it runs as sold


Language


Run the scenario in each language your reps sell in.


0 if any is missing, 2 if all work


Real-call link


Score the same behavior on each rep's next real call.


0 if no change, 2 if the miss is gone on most calls


Cost


Get a written quote for the plan that includes practice.


0 if practice needs a plan you would not otherwise buy, 2 if it fits the budget
